entities.name: 5-FU + mitomycin C
observations: Concurrent 5-FU plus mitomycin C is an established radiosensitizing regimen for bladder-preserving chemoradiotherapy in muscle-invasive bladder cancer; BC2001 tested this combination.

entities.name: Muscle-invasive bladder cancer
observations: For bladder-preserving chemoradiotherapy, concurrent radiosensitizing approaches include 5-FU plus mitomycin C; systemic cisplatin doublets should not be conflated with concurrent radiosensitization.
